events.title: Tupac Shakur: A Hip-Hop Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: The hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, we lost a hip-hop pioneer. Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: The iconic zebra crossing, the legendary tracks. The Beatles' Abbey Road album dropped this day in '69. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th to The Pretenders' incredible frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid, Liam Gallagher, turns 54 today! The voice of a generation, still bringing the swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's timeless message of peace, 'Imagine', was released on this day in '75. A song that still resonates.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. What was on your first one?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's cinematic legacy. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles member John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: The Beatles' sprawling, experimental 'White Album' was unleashed on the world this day in '68. A masterpiece.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day.

angles.name: Freddie's Unmatched Talent
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal album that changed everything. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived this day in '65, influencing countless artists.
